name: Guardian ~As The Master Wishes~
original_name: ガーディアン～As The Master Wishes～
source:
Yui Aso, a.k.a. Guardian, is revered by supernatural beings as their leader.

Enjoy the dream life of his harem of a dozen (12) busty beauties in harem play.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE170565.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
被稱為「守護者」的麻生唯，被超自然生靈奉為領袖。

十二位胸部豐滿的美人圍在他身邊，等你來體驗這段夢寐以求的後宮生活。

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE170565.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
